info.name: Nabta API
info.description:
REST API tests for the Nabta online plant store (Node.js + Express + MongoDB).

Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner: requests run top to bottom and save tokens/ids into collection variables.

Before running: start the server, run `npm run seed`, and set adminEmail/adminPassword to match server/.env.

request.description: Objects are converted to plain strings by the server, so operator injection does not work.
Choose a JPG/PNG/WEBP file (max 2 MB) in the Body tab for the 'image' field, then Send. The response contains the image URL to use as a product imageUrl.
